summary: Ferronordic AB (publ), together with its subsidiaries, operates as a dealer for new and used construction equipment and trucks in the United States, Germany, and Kazakhstan. The company also distributes excavators, wheel loaders, and mining machinery; mobile crushers and screens; telescopic and lattice boom cranes; backhoe loaders, compact wheel loaders, and other compact machines; haulers; wheeled and crawler excavators, and material handlers; and pavers, rollers, asphalt, and concrete mixing plants. In addition, the company engages in the rental, service, repair, and rebuilding of construction equipment, trucks, and associated equipment. Further, it provides technical support; consultancy services, such as machine operator training; aftermarket services and sales, including maintenance, diagnostics, overhauls, and spare parts sales; contracting; and other professional services. The company's brand portfolio includes Volvo Construction Equipment, Sandvik, Link-Belt Cranes, Hitachi Construction Machinery, Bergmann, Atlas, Mantsinen, Volvo Trucks, Renault Trucks, Mecalac, and Ammann. It serves the transport and logistics, general construction, road construction, mining, quarries and aggregates, government, recycling and waste, forestry, agriculture and landscaping, and other industries. The company was formerly known as Ferronordic Machines AB and changed its name to Ferronordic AB (publ) in July 2019. Ferronordic AB (publ) was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
